name: mcp-checklist
description: Reusable checklists and the dated runs of them: pass, fail, not applicable, and a sign-off.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: checklist_create
tools.description: Create a reusable checklist and return its CL-NNNN id: a name, a category and an optional description. Add the steps with checklist_item_add. Free tier: 3 checklists, and unlimited runs of them.

tools.name: checklist_item_add
tools.description: Add one step to a checklist and return its I01-style id: the text, an optional section heading, and whether it is required. A required step that is unanswered or failed blocks sign-off; an optional one does not.

tools.name: checklist_item_remove
tools.description: Remove one step from a checklist by its I01-style id and bump the checklist version. Runs already under way keep the step they started with, so nothing anybody already ticked is rewritten.

tools.name: checklist_show
tools.description: One checklist with its steps in order, grouped by section, plus how many are required and how many runs have been started from it. Pass as_text for a blank printable copy with a box against each step.

tools.name: checklist_list
tools.description: Every checklist with its category, version, step count and how many runs came from it. Filter by category or by a word in the name. Returns at most 500 rows, newest change first.

tools.name: checklist_delete
tools.description: Delete a checklist and its steps for good. Runs already started from it are untouched and stay readable: a run carries its own copy of the steps, so deleting the checklist does not erase what anybody signed.

tools.name: run_start
tools.description: Start a dated run of a checklist and return its RUN-YYYY-NNNN id. The steps are COPIED into the run, so editing the checklist afterwards never changes a run already under way. Runs are free and never capped.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Mark one step pass, fail or na, with who did it and when. na means the step did not apply; it counts as answered and never as passed. A step can be answered again while the run is open, and the last answer stands.

tools.name: run_show
tools.description: The whole run: every step with its answer, who answered it and when, grouped by section, plus the pass, fail and outstanding counts, the failures in full, and whether it can be signed off and why not.

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: Runs newest first, with their checklist, progress and sign-off state. Filter by checklist, by status, by reference or to open runs only. Returns at most 500 rows.

tools.name: run_sign_off
tools.description: Sign off a completed run with a name and a date, which freezes it. Refused while a required step is unanswered or failed, unless force is true, and either way the exceptions stay on the record and print on the report.

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: Move a run back to open so a step can be answered again, or abandon it when the job did not happen. A signed-off run is refused: a signature is the point at which a run stops moving.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: The run as plain text on every tier: every step with its mark, who answered it, the notes, the counts and a signature block or the recorded signature. Pro also writes it to out_path as a .txt file.

tools.name: run_delete
tools.description: Delete a run for good, with every answer on it. A signed-off run is refused: it is the record of what somebody put their name to. Abandon a run you no longer want instead of deleting a signed one.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
